own SVID per deviceztc-fog● ingest, windows, upstream, IDS◐ SWIM, Chord◐ offloading◐ migration endpointztc-ids(anomaly inside ztc-fog)● Modbus/GOOSE serviceztc-ingest● aggregate storeztc-migrate● RQ3 experiment CLIztcctl● policy, decide, keys, tokens◐ audit verify◐ segment exportsim/core + OMNeT++● C++ core, ZeroTrustFog

modelanalytics● parse, stats, figuresdeploy/● policies◐ docker, compose, k8s, monitoring, helm◐ generated NetworkPolicies, ACLs◐ terraform, ansible, ciscoCI● build, lint, race tests◐ e2e demo◐ images, SBOM◐ security scanning◐ sim, PythonDocs/● ADRs, architecture◐ courses, career◐ security◐ thesis results◐ portfolio
